## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2 (orchestration); DD5 (OVER_BOUND routing); DD1 (config validation).

## Implementation Notes
Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`:

1. **Pipeline orchestration** at the entry point (or in the existing main flow):
   - Pre-filter via file_filter.filter_diff(files, config) \xe2\x86\x92 (reviewable, skipped)
   - Compute total reviewable_lines; if < threshold_lines, run existing single-shot review path. If >= threshold_lines, take chunked path.
   - Chunked path: call region_split with Strategy F enabled \xe2\x86\x92 list of clusters.
   - Hard upper bound check: if len(clusters) > config.review.large_diff.max_files OR total_dispatches > max_files * max_calls, emit OVER_BOUND status; do NOT dispatch reviewers; return status to caller.
   - Otherwise: dispatch each cluster through existing primary\xe2\x86\x92fallback model chain (reuse current dispatch helper); collect cluster_results.
   - Call aggregator.aggregate_clusters(cluster_results, reviewable, skipped, pr_number, sha, cycle_num) \xe2\x86\x92 unified payload.
   - Emit single PR comment with the unified payload + visibility trailer.

2. **OVER_BOUND status**:
   - New status enum value 'OVER_BOUND' (distinct from existing FP-suspected, BLOCK, etc.)
   - Output to PR comment: 'OVER_BOUND: <N> clusters \xc3\x97 <M> calls exceeds max_files (%d) \xc3\x97 max_calls (%d). Routed to admin/FP-recovery.'
   - Status surfaced to /dso:fp-recovery as a rejected payload (see T8).

3. **Config validation at load**:
   - max_files=0 \xe2\x86\x92 emit warning to stderr 'review.large_diff.max_files=0 disables chunking; reviews on oversized diffs will fail open'. Do NOT raise.
   - max_calls=0 \xe2\x86\x92 same.
   - ignore.glob with no entries \xe2\x86\x92 emit warning 'review.large_diff.ignore.glob empty; consider defaults'. Use empty list (effectively no ignore beyond linguist tags).

After implementation: existing review tests should still pass (verify regression-free); T1, T3, T5 should already be GREEN from T2, T4, T6.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` | modify | Existing runner tests + new T8/T9 end-to-end | needs-modification |
| Config schema docs (dso-config.conf.example or similar) | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=\$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "\$TEST_CMD" ] && \$TEST_CMD
- [ ] runner.py imports file_filter, aggregator
  Verify: grep -qE 'from .file_filter|import file_filter' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] runner.py imports aggregator
  Verify: grep -qE 'from .aggregator|import aggregator' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] OVER_BOUND status defined
  Verify: grep -q 'OVER_BOUND' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] Config validation emits warnings on zero values
  Verify: grep -qE 'max_files=0|max_calls=0|warning.*max_files' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py
- [ ] Lint clean
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user.
